content.title: Selena Gomez Is Pretty In Pink In Prada Mini Dress At LA Beauty Event
content.text: Last Updated:April 04, 2026, 09:49 ISTActor-turned-entrepreneur Selena Gomez wore a pink Prada minidress for the launch of her new Rare Beauty foundation range.Selena Gomez in Los Angeles at a beauty launch event.Selena Gomez recently stepped out in a pink minidress for the launch of her new foundation range for the beauty brand she owns – Rare Beauty. For the makeup brand’s launch event in Los Angeles, USA, the singer-actor aced the theme and took the cuteness level up a notch.The Only Murders in the Building actor wore a bubblegum satin pink mini dress from Prada’s spring 2026 runway show. It was an elevated take on a T-shirt dress with a boxy silhouette and a white hemline that peeked out just a bit. But the most exciting aspect of this was the exposed pocket that sat at the front of the dress.Recommended StoriesAlia Bhatt Aces Desi Summer Fashion In Rs 82,800 Anavila Peach Kurta Set‘Can’t Believe This Is Happening’: Aditya Dhar On Anushka Sharma And Virat Kohli's Dhurandhar 2 ReviewWhy Rajpal Yadav Is Trending Again? A Look At His Recent HeadlinesEuphoria's Alexa Demie And Sydney Sweeney Sizzle On The Series' Premiere Red CarpetAnother fun part of Selena’s pretty pink frock was the in-built jewellery that came attached, removing the need to stress about accessories. The textured, embroidered collar was placed along the dress’s neckline, adding a touch of femininity. Selena Gomez further accessorised with silver hoop earrings and a couple of diamond rings as well. For her shoes, she added a pair of clean white slingbacks that matched the colour of her dress.She styled her hair in a sleek updo with a few tendrils of hair framing her face. For her makeup, she opted to go more natural and show off her foundation range. She matched the pink hue of her ensemble with her eyeshadow and kept the blush to a minimum.Selena Gomez To Make Directorial DebutWizards Beyond Waverly Place will end its run after its third season, and actor-singer Selena Gomez is making her directorial debut for the series premiere. The show will soon go into production sometime next week.The Wizards of Waverly Place launched Selena Gomez’s career back in the early 2000s, and she is set to make her directorial debut with the season three premiere. She will also reprise her role as Alex Russo in multiple episodes throughout the season, reported The Hollywood Reporter.Wizards Beyond Waverly Place continues the story of the original, which aired for four seasons on Disney Channel from 2007 to 2012. The original series followed the Russo siblings — Alex (Gomez), Justin (David Henrie), and Max (Jake T. Austin) — as they trained in magic under their father, Jerry (David DeLuise).The series ended with Alex winning the family wizard competition and gaining full control of the family’s powers.
